summary: Creates the first TurtleBlockAI physical/intellectual library catalog and seeds eleven photographed sources from the Commander-provided collection.

source_boundary.basis: Commander-provided photographs in ChatGPT project conversation

schema_decisions: Separate original work year, edition year, and chronology year.
Chronology can use original publication year, edition year, or anthology coverage start without pretending those dates are equivalent.
Digital complete-copy availability is explicit and defaults to unknown until verified.
Physical ownership status is separate from intellectual relevance.
Metadata verification provenance is retained so photographed facts remain distinguishable from later external verification.
Tags and contents are stored as JSON text for early flexibility; normalization can follow after the collection grows.

live_apply.execution_path: Authorized existing Cloudflare GitHub Actions token from CCC infrastructure was used for a one-off cross-repository Wrangler execution, then the temporary workflow was removed.
live_apply.migration_result: Executed 17 queries in 11.40ms; 63 rows read; 75 rows written.
live_apply.verification_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM library_sources;

privacy_boundary: No raw private dialogue, credentials, secrets, or external personal data were copied into the catalog.
